title: MultiblockCore: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common MultiblockCore failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If a structure will not validate, check orientation, block variants, controller position, required air spaces, and whether the blueprint belongs to the loaded addon set.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If validation fails, check orientation, block variants, controller location, missing air, loaded addon set, and whether the blueprint belongs to this structure.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
